source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC UART run `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_status` while host ON expecting `Host Run Power Status : Good / ON`; power host off and repeat expecting low.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds and responses are correct; collect evidence/photos/logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumes host SSH for both states despite losing host OS after off.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/critical; keeps the read but requires owner-supplied power-off/OOB observation and script-domain semantics.

old_problem: Script execution domain and surviving off-state access, GPIO/rail identity/polarity and exact low token, approved power-off mechanism, independent physical oracle, debounce/timing and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: The two-state readback is clear, but a host-OS command cannot run after host-off. ED-06/18 require a defined cycle state and complete recovery, while ED-03 forbids inventing the controller or off command. These are core command semantics rather than ordinary IP placeholders.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row147, same-row AI fields and history2534; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved BMC-UART context, exact status command, ON Good/ON value, approved off transition and second low read.
Separated read-only observations from destructive off and later recovery authorization.
Rejected host-SSH assumption, password/host-key weakening, invented off command, retry and DUT action.

test_case.purpose: Verify the same surviving-controller GPIO status interface distinguishes stable host ON from stable host OFF and correlates to independent rail/chassis evidence.
required_package: Powerctrl script domain/version/hash/owner and secure access path
Named GPIO/rail, polarity and exact stable ON/low grammar
Approved external power-off mechanism and idle/data-safety window
Independent rail/chassis observer plus timeout/debounce policy
Separately approved power-on recovery and post-boot health oracle
test_case.test_command: From the approved surviving controller, securely capture `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_status` and independent rail state while host is stably ON; after one separately authorized power-off, repeat the same read in stable OFF; correlate timestamps, then perform only the separately approved recovery with no automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: ON output exactly matches the signed Good/ON token with ON rails; after the approved transition the same controller reports the exact low token with OFF rails; no ambiguity/flapping occurs and subsequent authorized recovery restores full health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact signal/domain identity and both command-to-physical correlations. SSH loss alone, free-form text, unknown/flapping state, wrong polarity, timeout, incomplete OFF or failed recovery fails/blocks per engineer.
safety_gate: Prove the command domain remains powered/reachable after host-off.
Authorize the exact power-off separately after idle/data-safety checks.
Use secure credentials and verified target identity.
One bounded transition; no automatic power-cycle/retry; recovery is separately approved.
expected_evidence: Secure ON-state command output plus independent ON evidence
Authorized off action and timestamped transition/debounce timeline
Off-state same-command output plus independent OFF evidence
Separate recovery boot/service/filesystem/log health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If state is inconsistent or access is lost unexpectedly, preserve evidence and stop. Use only the pre-approved independent power-on/recovery path; do not infer success from reconnect or repeat the transition automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The two-state intent is coherent; execution domain and transition oracle are missing project specifications.

blocked.reason: Both observations are feasible after controller/signal and transition approval; this is RPUC, not intrinsic BLOCKED.
